answer: Let each agent in a dawn-to-dusk horizon survey register as a vertex using a manufacturer-certified secure element. The registry permits one active device key per serial number and assigns a fixed daily service quota to that hardware, even after key rotation. Signed challenges prove possession of the nonexportable key. Software aliases cannot create more certified devices, so an attacker must buy and operate additional hardware for every extra quota. This relies on an uncompromised issuer and enforcement against cloned certificates.
